review_scope: all accepted corpus-v2 development documents across the cleaned pilot and four expansion waves
method: Verified every local text against the hash and character count in its immutable stage report.
Normalized contributor, work, split-group and publisher identities for comparison without changing saved provenance.
Compared all 1,384 document pairs that cross stage boundaries with case-folded five-word-shingle Jaccard.
Indexed 9,778 paragraphs of at least 30 words and reviewed every cross-stage match reaching the 0.80 threshold.
Measured stage, domain, publisher, host and individual-document character concentration.
decision: Do not freeze splits. Acquire modern independent long-form prose against the measured era, genre, publisher and volume gaps, then rerun the audit before reserving a new test.
